defs.def: the female ruler of an independent state that has a royal family 女王；女酋长；女首领

ex.s: England’s Queen Elizabeth I could speak about 10 languages.
ex.t: 英格兰女王伊丽莎白一世会说大约10种语言。

ex.s: I bought a beautiful necklace for you, Mum—it looks just like one that Queen Cleopatra would have worn!
ex.t: 妈妈，我给你买了一条漂亮的项链——它看起来就像是埃及艳后克利奥帕特拉会戴的那种！

ex.s: Queens is a neighbourhood in the city of New York.
ex.t: 皇后区是纽约市的一个街区。

ex.s: In time, he rose to become a famous doctor, and even attended to Queen Victoria when she gave birth.
ex.t: 随着时间推移，他成长为一位著名的医生，甚至在维多利亚女王分娩时为她接生。

defs.def: the wife of a king 王后
a woman, place or thing that is thought to be one of the best in a particular group or area （某领域的）王后，精髓，精华

ex.s: I was the queen of the playground.

defs.def: a woman or girl chosen to perform official duties at a festival or celebration （节日或庆典活动中当选的）履行职责的女子
the most powerful piece used in the game of chess that can move any number of squares in any direction 后
a playing card with the picture of a queen on it 王后（牌）
a large female insect that lays eggs for the whole group （为群体产卵的）雌性昆虫，王；后

ex.s: Like bees, every RoboBee has a job to do/obeys a queen bee.
ex.t: 像蜜蜂一样，每只机器蜜蜂都有工作要做／服从蜂王的指挥。

defs.def: an offensive word for a male homosexual who behaves like a woman （女性化的男同性恋者贬称）王后，假娘儿们
